title: NeuroStar TMS: Relief when meds don’t work
description: Here’s the good news we love to share: 83% of patients who complete treatment with NeuroStar TMS report a reduction of their depression symptoms. A whopping 62% report a REMISSION of their symptoms, which mean they no longer meet the diagnostic criteria for depression! With outcomes like these, we can’t stay quiet.{.br}{.br}Does it hurt?
